name: openbb_economy_leading
description:
OECD composite leading indicator for a country (turning-point signal; 100 = long-term trend) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.composite_leading_indicator).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): country (lower case with underscores, e.g. united_states, g20; default united_states); provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts oecd only; schema default oecd, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it); no key.
US Conference Board style index: fred_leading_index. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"country": "united_states", "provider": "oecd"}

country.description: Country, lower case with underscores (e.g. united_states)
